title: Pumpbet
tagline: Introducing Pumpbet: an AI-powered challenge platform inspired by Charles Bronson's routine!
description:
Introduction: Hey! We're excited to introduce a workout challenge inspired by Charles Bronson's legendary fitness routine, powered by blockchain technology. Our goal is to promote healthy life  style, healthy food, and self-awareness.

The Problem: Staying motivated to work out consistently is tough, and people often quit before seeing results.

The Solution: The platform where users are challenged by AI. AI is ruthless and won't accept excuses. So there is no option to cheat. 

What We’ve Built So Far: We developed a working prototype that enables users to submit a video proof that they completed the challenge. Afterwards, our community member will be voting for the users to choose the winner of the round. In the future we plan to completely enable AI agents to run the platform.

Key Benefits:
1. Increased Motivation: With AI generated challenges, skipping workouts is no longer an option!
2. Transparency: Progress is securely recorded on the blockchain, ensuring honesty and accountability.
3. Community Support: You’ll be part of a community of fitness enthusiasts who encourage and challenge each other.

Conclusion: Pumpbet has the potential to be a game-changer in the fitness industry by combining proven workout methods with AI & cutting-edge web3 tech stack. As builders, our team is seeking the opportunity to further develop this concept at your hackathon, turning it into a fully functional product that can inspire and motivate people on their fitness journeys.

how_its_made:
Technologies Used:
1. Solidity: The backbone for our smart contracts, handling token staking and transactions.
2. Hardhat: For development and testing of our Ethereum-based smart contracts, allowing us to run a local blockchain environment.
3. TypeScript: Used for building our front-end application, ensuring type safety and better code quality.
4. OpenZeppelin: We leveraged OpenZeppelin’s libraries for secure, audited smart contracts, simplifying the implementation of token standards.
5. MACI: This technology aids in enhancing privacy and scalability for our voting and staking mechanisms
6. ai21: We use it to generate fitness challenges for participants
7. Subgraph: Our app now integrates with The Graph, enabling efficient and reliable access to decentralized data for seamless Web3 experiences.
8. Rainbow wallet integration: Our app now includes this wallet integration, allowing users to securely connect, manage their digital assets, and interact effortlessly with decentralized applications (we support Metamask, WalletConnect and Coinbase integrations).
